scope: Prepared device inputs; uncached backbone plus state-readout head. Synchronized steady calls exclude CPU checks, compile, input transfers and tokenization.
state_gate: FP16 state normalized RMSE <=0.002; FP32 allclose atol0.02/rtol0.005; all scores allclose atol0.02/rtol0.005; not a full-suite accuracy claim

contract.inputs: Existing contiguous FP32 [B,H,T<=2048,64] tensors and FP32 [B,H,64,64] initial state; int32 NPU lengths[B], caller guarantees 0<=length<=T
contract.outputs: FP32 [B,H,T,64], valid prefix matches reference; trailing outputs zero. FP32 [B,H,64,64] state after length updates. No mutation.
contract.model: B1 initially; lengths>=1; terminal EOS included in length
contract.adaptation: Skip recurrence updates in each tile at positions >= length; keep original padded strides. Read length on device per head. Original operator remains unchanged.

vector_manifest.contract: Contiguous [B,H,T<=2048,64], state [B,H,64,64], int32 lengths[B]; endpoint semantics; Ascend910B2
vector_manifest.precision: all recurrence tensors and arithmetic FP16
vector_manifest.launch: GetCoreNumAiv() instead of generic GetCoreNum(); same token/head algorithm

pipeline_scope: Warm filesystem read of a real NanoSCIDOCS batch, CPU tokenization/batch construction, synchronous pageable H2D, uncached selected-backend backbone/head, D2H scores, JSON write without fsync. Excludes startup, dataset indexing, tokenizer initialization, compilation and profiling. Device-event elapsed can include CPU gaps.
